title: Hybrid rocket motor
description: Solid fuel, liquid oxidizer. The fuel grain sits in the case like a solid motor's, but it contains no oxidizer, so it only burns while oxidizer is sprayed over it. One valve starts, throttles and stops the motor. Safer than a solid and simpler than a liquid engine, but less efficient than either.

reference.note: No dimensions are published for this motor. The size, proportions and every internal detail of the model are representative.

flow_model.note: Streak speed follows local flow speed on a compressed scale. Speeds inside the tank, valve and fuel port are nominal values.

parts.title: Fill and vent fitting
parts.description: Used to load the oxidizer before flight and to vent it afterwards.

parts.title: Oxidizer tank
parts.description: Holds liquid nitrous oxide. Nitrous oxide's own vapour pressure pushes it out, so the motor needs no pump and no separate pressurant.

parts.title: Thrust flange
parts.description: Ring around the tank that passes the thrust into the vehicle's structure. This motor has no gimbal.

parts.title: Thrust skirt
parts.description: Joins the fuel case to the tank and carries the thrust forward. The openings give access to the valve.

parts.title: Main oxidizer valve
parts.description: The motor's throttle and off switch. Closing it stops the oxidizer, and the fire goes out. A solid motor cannot do this.

parts.title: Injector
parts.description: Sprays the liquid oxidizer into the front of the fuel port.

parts.title: Igniters
parts.description: Small pyrotechnic igniters that light the fuel surface as the oxidizer begins to flow.

parts.title: Case bolts
parts.description: Fasten the injector and thrust skirt to the front of the fuel case.

parts.title: Fuel case
parts.description: Composite tube that holds the fuel grain and the combustion pressure. Like a solid motor, the case is the combustion chamber.

parts.title: Insulation
parts.description: Liner that protects the case as the fuel burns away toward it.

parts.title: Fuel grain
parts.description: Solid rubber fuel, with no oxidizer mixed in. On its own it cannot burn, which makes it safe to handle. It burns only where oxidizer flows over the surface of the port.

parts.title: Nozzle bolts
parts.description: Fasten the nozzle to the aft end of the case.

parts.title: Nozzle throat
parts.description: Uncooled throat of carbon material. It survives the flame for the length of the burn.

parts.title: Exit cone
parts.description: Composite cone that expands the exhaust to high speed.
